prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity compositional option C for the Grădina Kasper desktop homepage, 1536×1024 landscape
Primary request: Explore the same “Friendly Weekly Harvest” identity through a GREENHOUSE-FIRST composition. Create one continuous rounded photographic ribbon that shows real people growing and packing vegetables, with the website’s offer and featured box interface embedded alongside it. The result must be a real ecommerce homepage, not a poster and not a literal planner.
Structure: Existing homepage information architecture only. Compact navigation. First viewport uses a continuous greenhouse ribbon across roughly two-thirds of the width, while a vertical stack of calm tonal content blocks contains the headline and one featured “Cutia Family” purchase module. Keep the CTA visible. At the lower fold, show the start of the existing highlighted-articles section using large image-led editorial previews. No how-it-works section or new functionality.
Composition: human story leads, then the eye lands on the box action. Use broad rounded containers and tonal separation, not outlines. Keep one strong deep-green block, one pale primary field, and mostly white breathing room. No more than one outlined secondary control.
Limited palette only: primary-50 #eefbf2, primary-100 #d6f5de, primary-300 #7dd8a0, primary-600 #17844a, primary-900 #005621, primary-950 #072718; secondary-50 #f5f9ec, secondary-200 #c6dc9a, secondary-500 #7ca33f, secondary-800 #3e5024; white allowed as neutral. Natural vegetable colors appear only inside real photography.
Exact visible Romanian text: “Grădina Kasper”; “Din grădina noastră. Direct pe masa ta. Proaspăt din Brașov.”; “Cutia Family”; “150 RON”; “4–5 kg”; “Următoarea livrare: 28.09.2026”; “Adaugă în coș”; “Vezi toate cele 18 cutii”; “Articole recomandate”.
Visual character: friendly rounded display typography inspired by the references; precise hierarchy; generous but not empty; playful through scale and curvature rather than decorative stickers.
Constraints: the visitor must know what is sold, see human greenhouse evidence, and have a clear product action within seconds; no invented claims or extra business content; compatible with the preserved dark-green rounded footer.
Avoid: excessive borders, bordered card grids, coral, orange, red, purple, gradients, glassmorphism, generic ShadCN, literal meal-planning or calendar UI, handwritten notes, cartoons, luxury minimalism, fake certifications, testimonials, discounts, ratings, fake statistics, poster composition, watermark.
